name: Polaris
description_en: Music browsing and streaming application optimized for large music collections, ease of use and high performance. `MIT` `Rust/Docker`
description: Polaris is a music streaming application, designed to let you enjoy your music collection from any computer or mobile device.
readme_preview:
![Polaris Web UI](res/readme/web_ui.png?raw=true "Polaris Web UI")
Polaris is a self-hosted music streaming server, to enjoy your music collection from any computer or mobile device. It is free and open-source software, without any kind of premium version.
